parse_sql_split_query: parse a SQL query string into its table name and uppercase operation keywords
format_query_structured_args: format a SQL query with arguments into a dictionary mapping column names to values
parse_sql_review: review the parse_sql function to understand how it splits queries into table and operation parts
format_query_summarize: summarize the format_query function that extracts keys from parentheses and zips them with arguments
parse_sql_test: test the parse_sql function with a sample SQL query string to verify table and operation parsing
